title.narrative: Supporting the economic empowerment of the artisanal fishing community of the Republic of Mauritius

description.narrative: The proposed action addresses the issue of empowering the artisanal fishers of the Republic of Mauritius in getting out of poverty by filling gaps identified in existing governments measures. The action at the same time addresses the issue of sustainable management and biodiversity conservation of the lagoon area which, at present, are exploited by several competing users
